purpose: Master coverage contract for scalable K01 engineering. Every active engineering domain must be represented by an authority, graph nodes/evidence path, stale-propagation rule and release disposition. Missing active domains are explicit gaps, never silently omitted.
principles: The lifecycle is a DAG with one main definition spine and parallel evidence/product-structure lanes, not a single sequential checklist.
Product Definition owns engineering semantics; solver/drawing/BOM/inspection artifacts are downstream evidence/projections.
Every derived output is bound to input fingerprints, toolchain identity and configuration/effectivity.
A domain may be OPEN or not yet graph-backed, but that state must be declared here with an owner/action; silent absence is prohibited.
Physics evidence families are independent: structural, magnetic, flow, thermal, pressure/vacuum and other applicable domains stale independently.
EBOM and MBOM are different controlled products: EBOM from product/CAD structure; MBOM additionally consumes manufacturing transformation/route.
CalculiX / CCX is the controlled name for the independent structural cross-check branch.
FEMM is magnetic-field evidence; unverified force extraction must not become release evidence.
Center is a projection/orchestration surface and never a second authority database.

domains.title: Requirements / allocation / engineering decision / technical filter
domains.status_note: Technical-filter evidence remains a cross-cutting decision gate and must be linked by changes/nodes; equal numeric values never imply shared identity.

domains.title: Derived loads / limits / screening inputs
domains.status_note: Derived quantities have stable IDs, quantity kind, derivation and consumers; they are not requirements.

domains.title: Product Characteristics / datums / measurement / effectivity
domains.status_note: Nominal, fit/tolerance/GD&T, datum/DRF, measurement condition, material/surface/process, inspection strategy and OPEN/PARTIAL/CONTROLLED state live here.

domains.title: Native CAD / semantic binding / MBD-PMI
domains.status_note: Runtime face IDs are not authority. Critical binding requires semantic/geometric signature plus reopen/rebuild/perturb invariance as applicable.

domains.title: Drawing authoring / projection / D1-D9 QA
declared_gaps: D8 controlled visual QA for exemplar
D3 L3 controlled perturb/restore recipe and execution for release-native binding invariance
D7 full release scope after all Product Definition claims/configuration/effectivity are closed
domains.status_note: V17 makes exemplar provenance and D3 authority/execution mapping explicit. Current exemplar still must pass D3 semantic corrections, then D7/D8/D9; release remains incomplete until D3 L3/full D7/D8/D9 and upstream blockers close.

domains.title: Tolerance stack / variation / process capability / inspectability
domains.status_note: Variation evidence is separate from physics and stales on tolerance/datum/measurement/manufacturing changes.

domains.title: Structural FEA — SolidWorks Simulation primary screen + CalculiX independent branch
domains.status_note: SolidWorks linear-static screen has evidence. CalculiX/CCX is independent reconciliation and may remain blocked until neutral mesh/toolchain is available; a controlled waiver would be required for release if cross-check remains mandatory.

domains.title: Magnetic FEM — FEMM
domains.status_note: Solver/field screening evidence exists with limitations. Absolute force extraction remains unverified and cannot be used as release evidence until fixed/validated.

domains.title: Flow / purge / pressure-drop CFD
declared_gaps: Current Flow Simulation evidence/goals are not yet normalized into authoritative MEDTAS graph nodes and fingerprints.
domains.gap_action: Create controlled FLOW input-case/evidence nodes when flow requirements enter a release decision; bind inlet/outlet/purge/temperature assumptions and solver version.

domains.title: Thermal / thermal-preload / galling-service evidence
declared_gaps: Thermal workpack exists but no dedicated thermal solver/evidence node is yet in authoritative graph.
domains.gap_action: Split thermal loads/material properties/contact/preload effects into fingerprinted thermal evidence node(s) before thermal release claims.

domains.title: Pressure / vacuum / containment / leak
declared_gaps: Pressure/vacuum envelope is controlled by EDR, but containment/leak calculation/test acceptance is not yet a dedicated graph evidence family.
domains.gap_action: Create pressure/containment and leak-test evidence nodes consuming C07/C08/C10/C12, material/process and pressure envelope.

domains.title: Materials / joining / manufacturing route / supplier capability
domains.status_note: P007 monolithic vs joined/welded route remains release-significant. Process-dependent characteristics may not be closed before route/capability evidence.

domains.title: Engineering BOM (EBOM)
domains.status_note: EBOM is computed from controlled CAD occurrence tree + product registry. Manual BOM tables are not authority.

domains.title: Manufacturing BOM (MBOM) / manufacturing transformation
domains.status_note: MBOM consumes EBOM plus manufacturing route/process decomposition; open P007 route must propagate here.

domains.title: Inspection / metrology / acceptance
domains.status_note: Inspection strategy is defined with characteristics; S6 owns procedure/results. Measurement condition and capability are release semantics, especially for thin-wall P007.

domains.title: Configuration / effectivity / release baseline
domains.status_note: Historical released revisions are immutable. As-built/as-inspected evidence pins exact released fingerprints.

domains.title: Repository / Git / handoff / toolchain reproducibility
domains.status_note: Patch-first controlled changes, source/toolchain hashes and complete AI handoff prevent branch/session drift.
